comments:
Discussed in [FFQQBB4J] and [URNFGAXV]. 
Commentary on the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā (ID:3715), presenting itself as the explanation of the Indian scholar Hasumati (i.e., Mahāsumat) being written down. The author appears to endorse these explanations. The first part of the work articulates the Svātantrika-Prāsaṅgika distinction.

Diplomatic edition of (ID:4519), fols. 30a1-37b11 and German translation in [RZ74ZGVR].
